asr_text: Stonewatchers were more likely to cut another person's reward only those high in sadistic tendencies in one experiment, but people at every level in another. The findings suggest that the choices available in a situation may matter alongside personality, but these separate brief experiments do not show that offering an increase option prevents meanness or that the findings apply to everyday life.
